name: Chiranosuke
source: A talking cat resembling a Persian Cat spirit who informs Yuuta about spirit powers and serves as a guide to get him to save the world. His name is a pun on "chira no suke." "chira" means "glimpse/peek," and "sukebe" translates to "lecher," so basically he is a lecher who peeks.
